title: Builders FirstSource stock trades below consensus as investors build new positions

title: VC funding deals: Digs, Builders FirstSource, Vessev, Blackbird, Math Magic
ai_summary: Digs raised $25.3 million in Series A from Builders FirstSource, Vessev raised $19 million for electric hydrofoil vessels, and Math Magic raised nearly $50 million across two rounds. The funding supports AI homebuilding, electric passenger vessels, and AI 3D content creation, respectively.

title: Digs Raises $25.3M in Series A Funding
ai_summary: Digs, a Vancouver-based AI and digital twin platform for residential construction, raised $25.3 million in Series A funding from Builders FirstSource. The investment brings total funding to over $47 million, and the company will use the capital to expand its workforce to over 60 and scale national sales. Builders FirstSource will integrate Digs' SaaS into its ecosystem for over 140,000 homebuilders.

title: Builders FirstSource Leads $25.3M Series A for Digs
ai_summary: Builders FirstSource led a $25.3 million Series A round for Vancouver, Washington-based AI startup Digs, backing a five-year partnership to build an AI-powered platform that creates a "digital twin" of a home. The platform will consolidate construction documents into a single source covering plans, specifications, approvals and project history, plus AI chats, diagramming and homeowner guides.

title: Builders FirstSource Leads $25.3M Series A for Digs
ai_summary: Builders FirstSource led a $25.3 million Series A round for Digs, a Vancouver, Washington startup making AI software for residential construction, as part of a five-year partnership. The deal will expand Builders FirstSource's digital platform, turning construction documents into a single source covering plans, specifications, approvals and project history, plus AI chats, diagramming and homeowner guides.

title: Builders FirstSource unveils AI platform partnership with Digs
ai_summary: Builders FirstSource has closed a $25.3 million Series A round for AI platform Digs, forming a five-year partnership focused on product development and platform integration. The deal will bring Digs' AI features to residential homebuilders, including digital twins of homes, and add AI chat, electronic signatures and project collaboration tools.

title: Builders FirstSource Leads $25.3 Million Digs Funding Round, Signs Five-Year AI Deal
ai_summary: Builders FirstSource led a $25.3 million Series A funding round for construction tech firm Digs and signed a five-year agreement to integrate Digs' AI into its digital platform. The deal aims to connect product data and purchasing with AI tools for estimating and project management. No details were disclosed on investment amounts, ownership stakes, or rollout timelines.

title: Builders FirstSource Partners with Digs on AI-Powered Homebuilding Platform
ai_summary: Builders FirstSource announced on Aug. 25 a strategic partnership with AI provider Digs, becoming the sole lead investor in Digs' $25.3 million Series A and signing a five-year commercial agreement. The companies will integrate Digs' AI platform, which converts construction documents into centralized project information, across estimating, procurement, construction and post-construction services. BFS serves more than 140,000 customers and operates about 565 locations across 43 states.

title: Homebuilding AI startup Digs raises $25.3M and partners with building products giant
ai_summary: Vancouver, Wash.-based homebuilding AI startup Digs raised $25.3 million in Series A funding led by building products giant Builders FirstSource, announced Tuesday. Under a five-year agreement, Builders FirstSource will integrate Digs' AI platform into its digital ecosystem, serving 140,000 builder clients. Digs has 37 employees and plans to double to more than 60 by year-end.
